fire: Monks try to live a simple life, a quiet life and a prayerful life.
Every person has a family life, a working life and an inner life.
She wanted a creative life, a free life, a life of her own.
The program helps patients lead a healthy life, a social life and an active life.
He dreamed of a peaceful life, a rural life far from the city.
Writers often lead a public life, a private life and a secret life.
Retirement can offer a slower life, a fuller life, a richer life.
The novel contrasts a married life, a lonely life and a wasted life.
quiet: Monks try to live simply, quietly and with constant prayer.
Every person balances family, work and their own thoughts.
She wanted creativity, freedom and time of her own.
The program helps patients eat well, sleep well and exercise.
He dreamed of peace and quiet far from the city.
Writers often keep their public and private worlds apart.
Retirement can offer slower days and more time with friends.
The novel contrasts marriage, loneliness and wasted years.
